svg.text: Speed relative to the fastest Faust build of the same contract (the ×1 line): up, faster than Faust; down, slower. Log scale.
Strict IEEEgeometric means: Onda ×0.93 · Cmajor ×0.70 · YDSP ×0.63 · C++ ×0.94
fast-mathgeometric means: Onda ×0.77 · Cmajor ×0.59 · YDSP ×0.59 · C++ ×0.83
Apple M5 · f32 · 48 kHz · 256-frame blocks. Cmajor uses its faster backend (C++ or LLVM JIT).
Bars outside the axis range are clipped.
